typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		entry_time as date,
		trade_date as string,
		settle_date as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		counterparty as string,
		isin as string,
		currency as string,
		total_cash as string,
		principal as string,
		current_par as string,
		price as string,
		salesperson as string,
		import_source as string,
		security_description as string,
		accrued_interest as string,
		cusip as string,
		category as string,
		captureDate as timestamp,
		legal_entity as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystTrade	source(output(
		entry_time as date,
		trade_date as timestamp,
		settle_date as timestamp,
		import_source as string,
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		salesperson as string,
		counterparty as string,
		buy_sell as string,
		security_description as string,
		current_par as string,
		principal as string,
		accrued_interest as string,
		total_cash as string,
		currency as string,
		isin as string,
		cusip as string,
		price as string,
		category as string,
		trade_state as string,
		allocatedDate as date,
		aging as integer,
		legal_entity as string,
		captureDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
fromtblCatalystTrade,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(fromtblCatalystTrade@entry_time == LookupLKPTABLE@entry_time && fromtblCatalystTrade@catalyst_trade_number == LookupLKPTABLE@catalyst_trade_number,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		catalyst_trade_number = fromtblCatalystTrade@catalyst_trade_number,
		entry_time = fromtblCatalystTrade@entry_time,
		trade_date = fromtblCatalystTrade@trade_date,
		settle_date = fromtblCatalystTrade@settle_date,
		buy_sell = fromtblCatalystTrade@buy_sell,
		counterparty = fromtblCatalystTrade@counterparty,
		isin = fromtblCatalystTrade@isin,
		currency = fromtblCatalystTrade@currency,
		total_cash = fromtblCatalystTrade@total_cash,
		principal = fromtblCatalystTrade@principal,
		current_par = fromtblCatalystTrade@current_par,
		price = fromtblCatalystTrade@price,
		salesperson = fromtblCatalystTrade@salesperson,
		import_source = fromtblCatalystTrade@import_source,
		security_description = fromtblCatalystTrade@security_description,
		accrued_interest = fromtblCatalystTrade@accrued_interest,
		cusip = fromtblCatalystTrade@cusip,
		category = fromtblCatalystTrade@category,
		captureDate = fromtblCatalystTrade@captureDate,
		legal_entity = fromtblCatalystTrade@legal_entity,
		trade_state = trade_state,
		allocatedDate = allocatedDate,
		aging = aging
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		current_par as string,
		entry_time as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		total_cash as string,
		cusip as string,
		settle_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		security_description as string,
		trade_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		principal as string,
		salesperson as string,
		price as string,
		counterparty as string,
		currency as string,
		legal_entity as string,
		accrued_interest as string,
		captureDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		buy_sell as string,
		import_source as string,
		category as string,
		isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		current_par,
		entry_time,
		total_cash,
		cusip,
		settle_date,
		security_description,
		trade_date,
		catalyst_trade_number,
		principal,
		salesperson,
		price,
		counterparty,
		currency,
		legal_entity,
		accrued_interest,
		captureDate,
		buy_sell,
		import_source,
		category,
		isin),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystUnallocatedTradesLondonStaging
